name: ATM Transfer Request V 02
definition: The ATMTransferRequest message is sent by an ATM to an ATM manager to request the approval of a fund transfer at the ATM.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the protocol management on a segment of the path from the ATM to the acquirer.

ATMTransferRequest.name: ATM Transfer Request
ATMTransferRequest.definition: Information related to the request of a fund transfer from an ATM.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC.
